c: Mix flour, water and yeast to a smooth batter; cover; ferment until bubbly and just collapsing.
Mix flour and water; autolyse 30 min; add poolish, yeast and salt; mix 6 min slow + 3 min fast (dough 24 °C).
Bulk 1 h 30 min with 2 folds; divide 290 g; pre-shape; rest 20 min.
Shape 55 cm baguettes; prove on couche 45–60 min.
Score 5 cuts; bake 250 °C with steam 22–24 min until deep golden; cool on racks.
Mix the yeast into the flour away from the salt; add the milk (25 °C), eggs, sugar and salt. Knead on low 3 min, then medium 5 min.
Add the soft butter in 3 additions; knead until smooth and elastic (windowpane test). Final dough temperature 24–26 °C.
Bulk-ferment covered 60 min at room temperature (or retard overnight at 4 °C).
Divide into 90 g pieces; pre-shape tight rounds, rest 10 min, re-round, place on a lined tray and flatten to 9 cm.
Proof 60–75 min at 28–30 °C, 75 % RH, until doubled.
Brush gently with the egg wash and sprinkle with sesame.
Bake at 180 °C convection for 14–16 min to a core of 92–94 °C and a deep golden colour. Cool on a rack.
5ff49e86.st: Airtight, ambient, 24 h; −18 °C, 1 month (thaw covered at room temperature).

Bulk 1 h 30 min; divide 12 × 155 g; roll 40 cm strands.
Braid 2 six-strand loaves; prove 1 h; egg-wash twice; sprinkle seeds.
2705d009.al: 1 Gluten (strong bread flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs, egg yolks) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds)

d6690d89.yl: Yield: 4 loaves × ≈ 420 g baked · 32 slices · Portion: ≈ 50 g
c: Mix to a shaggy dough (no kneading); cover; ferment 16–18 h at 18 °C.
Mix biga, flour, 480 g water and yeast 5 min slow; add salt, then the remaining water in a stream; mix 8 min medium until it pulls from the bowl; add oil.
Bulk 2 h in an oiled tub with folds at 30, 60, 90 min.
Tip onto a well-floured bench; cut 4 rectangles without degassing; place on semolina-dusted couche; prove 40 min.
Flip onto peel; bake 240 °C deck with steam 25–28 min; vent last 5 min; core 96 °C.
Mix flour, water, yeast, salt and 50 g oil 8 min; add olives and herbs; bulk 1 h 30 min.
Divide 4; flatten to ovals 1.5 cm; cut the leaf pattern; stretch the openings.
Prove 30 min; brush with oil; flaky salt.

Shape 66 g rolls with wet hands; prove 40 min.
Bake 230 °C with steam 25 min until hollow-sounding.
8750bf60.st: −18 °C 1 month. Store apart from wheat breads.

Whisk psyllium into warm water; gel 5 min.
Mix with remaining ingredients 5 min to a thick dough; shape with wet hands into an oiled 1 kg tin.
Prove 45–60 min; bake 220 °C 60–65 min to core 98 °C; cool fully before slicing.
7c716b86.st: Sliced −18 °C 1 month (toast from frozen). Store apart from wheat breads.

7c6ce949.yl: Yield: 2 loaves (20 slices) · Portion: 1 slice ≈ 75 g
c: Mix flours and 620 g water; autolyse 30 min; add yeast, salt and remaining water; knead 10 min; add oil.
Bulk 2 h at 24 °C with 2 folds, then 4 °C 12 h.
Shape 2 round loaves; mist; roll tops in sesame; prove 1 h at 26 °C.
Bake with steam 230 °C 15 min, then 210 °C 25–30 min until hollow-sounding (1760 → ≈ 1500 g).
7c6ce949.al: 1 Gluten (strong bread flour, wheat flour) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds)

Add buttermilk and treacle; mix just to a soft dough (do not knead).
Shape 2 rounds; dust with flour; cut a deep cross.
Bake at once 220 °C 15 min, then 200 °C 25 min until hollow-sounding; cool under a cloth.
81acbe00.st: Best on the day; toast on day 2; −18 °C 1 month.
81acbe00.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, wholemeal wheat flour, rolled oats) · 7 Milk (butter, buttermilk)

c2d96050.yl: Yield: 1 loaf, GN 1/3 (325 × 176 × 100 mm) · ≈1030 g · 18 slices · Portion: 57 g
c: Combine the flour, sugar and yeast.
Add the milk, water and egg; mix to a rough dough.
Add the salt and knead for 5 min.
Add the butter gradually; knead 10–15 min to full gluten development (windowpane test). Dough 24–26 °C.
Bulk ferment at 26–28 °C for 60–90 min until doubled.
Grease the GN 1/3 pan with the butter.
Divide the dough into 2 pieces of ≈578 g; round and rest 20 min.
Roll each into a 30 × 15 cm rectangle; fold both long sides to the centre.
Turn 90°, roll to 30 × 10 cm and roll up tightly from the short side.
Place both rolls seam-side down in the pan, parallel to the long side, 2–3 cm apart.
Proof at 30 °C, 75–80% humidity, for 45–60 min until the dough reaches 80–90% of the pan height.
Bake in a combi oven at 170 °C, hot air, low fan, 0% humidity, for 30–35 min to a core temperature of 93–95 °C.
Unmould immediately and cool on a rack before slicing.
c2d96050.st: Ambient (18–22 °C), well wrapped: 2–3 days. Frozen at −18 °C: 1 month.

a19905a3.yl: Yield: 25 rolls × 60 g · Portion: 1 roll 60 g
c: Mix 5 min slow + 4 min fast (dough 25 °C); bulk 45 min.
Divide 68 g; round; rest 10 min; flatten; fold 5 overlapping points (or use a Kaiser stamp).
Prove upside-down on poppy seeds 40 min; turn over.
Bake 240 °C with steam 15–17 min until golden and crisp.

ff2c805c.yl: Yield: 20 pretzels × 70 g · Portion: 1 pretzel 70 g
c: Mix a stiff dough 8 min; rest 20 min; divide 80 g.
Roll 50 cm ropes, thick in the middle; twist into pretzels.
Chill uncovered 1 h to form a skin.
Dip 30 s in the alkaline bath; drain; salt; score the thick belly.
Simmer 6 % baking soda solution (or 4 % food-grade lye, cold, with gloves and goggles); use stainless steel only.
ff2c805c.st: Best on the day; −18 °C baked 1 month.

Mix flours, water, yeast and honey 5 min; add salt and soaker; mix 4 min (dough 25 °C).

024a01ad.al: 1 Gluten (rolled oats, strong bread flour, wholemeal wheat flour, rye flour) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds)

814fe94a.yl: Yield: 30 rolls × 55 g · Portion: 1 roll 55 g

Bulk 1 h with 1 fold; divide 65 g; round.
Prove 45 min; brush with oil; bake 230 °C with steam 15 min.
Mix flours and water; autolyse 30 min; add yeast, salt and honey; mix 6 min; add walnuts on slow.

3e3afceb.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, rye flour) · 8 Nuts (walnuts). Vegan. Contains 8 Nuts.

Bulk 1 h; divide in 2; shape tight logs; place in buttered lidded tins.

Bake 200 °C 35–40 min; unmould at once; cool fully before slicing.

Mix all to a soft dough 8 min (dough 26 °C); bulk 1 h.
Divide 68 g; round; place close together in trays.

Beat in eggs one at a time, then cheese, to a sticky dough.
Scoop 25 g balls with oiled hands onto lined trays (freeze if needed).
Bake 200 °C 20–25 min until puffed and golden; serve warm.
1f7dd054.st: Raw balls −18 °C 2 months (bake from frozen +5 min).

Mix everything 8 min to a thick paste.

Mix 6 min slow + 2 min fast to a sticky dough (28 °C); bulk 30 min.
Divide 920 g; shape round with wet hands; place seam-up in floured bannetons.
Prove 50–60 min until the surface cracks.
Bake 250 °C with steam 10 min, then 210 °C 45 min to core 96 °C; cool 12 h before slicing.
c493ddb0.st: Wrapped at room temperature 5 days; −18 °C 2 months.
c493ddb0.al: 1 Gluten (rye flour, sourdough starter, wheat flour)

Whisk dry; whisk wet; combine just until mixed.

Whip butter with honey and salt until light.

56c1e766.yl: Yield: 30 rolls × 50 g baked · Portion: 1 roll = 50 g

Add soft butter; mix until smooth and elastic (window-pane), dough 26 °C.
Bulk 45 min; divide 57 g; round tightly; place on trays 2 cm apart.

Brush gently with egg wash; sprinkle half with sesame (optional).

56c1e766.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds)

c17f110e.yl: Yield: 2 loaves × ≈ 850 g baked · 36 slices · Portion: ≈ 47 g

8e2d776e.al: 1 Gluten (spelt flour, strong bread flour) · 7 Milk (yoghurt 3.6%)

Bake 160 °C 60–70 min until a skewer comes out clean; cool in tins.

Paper cups in muffin trays; 69 g batter per cup (scoop), about ¾ full.

Bulk 1 h at room temperature; knock back; retard at 0–4 °C for 12 h.
Divide 50 g, shape; proof at 28 °C 1.5–2 h (×2 volume).

Beat cream cheese, icing sugar and milk; spread over the warm rolls.

Dissolve salt and soda in 50 ml water; beat in; rest 20 min.

Remove rings; flip 1 min; serve toasted with butter.

Pipe 20 g crème pâtissière (see TTK) into each centre; top with one apricot half (25 g), cut side down.
Brush the fruit and edges with warm neutral glaze.

Roll 25 cm ropes; join into rings; place on semolina-dusted trays.
Poach 30 s per side in the honey bath; top with seeds.
Bake 240 °C 16–18 min until glossy and golden.
Bring to a simmer in a wide pot.
edc56256.st: Best on the day; slice and freeze −18 °C 1 month.

c: Boil milk with split vanilla; whisk yolks, sugar and starch; temper with milk.
Return to the pan; boil 1–2 min whisking; off heat add butter.
Spread on a tray, cover with film in contact; chill fast to 4 °C.
Soak raisins in rum and hot water 1 h; drain.
Roll laminated dough 4 mm into a 30 × 60 cm rectangle; spread crème pât.; scatter raisins.
Roll up tightly from the long side; chill 20 min; slice 3 cm.
Bake 180 °C 16–18 min; glaze with hot apricot jam.
e70f805b.al: 1 Gluten (croissant / danish dough) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks, croissant / danish dough, eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, croissant / danish dough). Vegetarian.

Egg-wash twice; snip tops; sprinkle pearl sugar.

Whip butter with honey; fold in flakes at the end.
Beat butter with finely chopped olives and rosemary.
Pipe or roll each butter in film; chill; serve 15 g quenelles at 12–14 °C.

Ready when it doubles within 6–8 h of feeding and smells pleasantly sour.
Feed every 24 h at room temperature (or weekly from 0–4 °C storage); label date and time.
Mix to a firm dough; use at peak (doubled, domed).
